description: This Java source file defines the 'LoanAccountAutoStarter' configuration class within the Fineract project. It registers various beans related to loan repayment schedule transaction processors, applying conditional logic to load specific implementations based on runtime conditions.

classes.name: LoanAccountAutoStarter
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that defines and conditionally registers various loan repayment schedule processors as beans.

methods.name: creocoreLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for the Creocore loan repayment schedule transaction processor if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: earlyPaymentLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for the early repayment loan schedule processor based on conditions.

methods.name: fineractStyleLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for the standard Fineract style loan repayment schedule processor.

methods.name: heavensFamilyLoanRepyamentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for the Heavens Family loan repayment schedule processor.

methods.name: interestPrincipalPenaltyFeesOrderLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for loan repayment schedule processor handling interest, principal, and penalties with specific ordering.

methods.name: principalInterestPenaltyFeesOrderLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for loan repayment schedule processor handling principal, interest, and penalties with specific ordering.

methods.name: rbiLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for RBI-specific loan repayment schedule processor.

methods.name: duePenFeeIntPriInAdvancePriPenFeeIntLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for a specific loan schedule processor involving fees and interests in advance.

methods.name: duePenIntPriFeeInAdvancePenIntPriFeeLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for a loan schedule processor managing fees and interests in advance.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorFactory
methods.description: Provides a factory for loan repayment schedule processors, defaulting to a specified processor if none other matches.

methods.name: advancedPaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Creates a bean for advanced payment schedule processing, incorporating EMI calculations and schedule components.
